'''Justin Abdallah Your Insight Does Not Server You Well Sir''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Justin Abdallah]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-9021">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9021 Your Insight Does Not Server You Well Sir], DeckTech (justin "Grendal" abdallah, 2 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9021/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9021/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018144042/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9021/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Justin Abdallah]]
* '''Published:''' 2 August 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Your Insight Does Not Server You Well Sir''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 TIGIH Abdallah LS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Paige: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' using the new i can save him objective i plan on draining the life away from opponent with scouts and using the objective to its full advantage.

== Original post ==

'''Your Insight Does Not Server You Well Sir'''
* '''Author:''' justin "Grendal" abdallah
* '''Published:''' August 2, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' using the new i can save him objective i plan on draining the life away from opponent with scouts and using the objective to its full advantage.

=== Strategy ===

this deck is pretty self explanatory.  i'm sure it works really well against the new dark side objective.	anyway, i really like the corporal midge and han combo.  At the back door its a drain of 3-4 if u have leia with her stick.  You can also slap a blaster on midge and get major weapon destiny draws.  I absolutely love major panno.  in this deck he's nice cuz u get an extra force generation of 4, plus two more at any site luke is.  Basically just spread thin using all the scouts and also spread thin is space, The space portion isnt that strong but maybe someone could help on that.
